note: #2767 item 9 (comment-looking text inside a Markdown link title masked as a real HTML comment): findHtmlCommentRanges's ignored-opener-ranges input only ever receives real code ranges (fenced/indented/inline); a link title is ordinary prose, never a code range, so the "<!--" opener inside the link title is not ignored. It is also unterminated in this body (no "-->" anywhere), so it masks from that point through end-of-body, swallowing the genuine, later "Maintainer decision (...)" marker entirely -- this also fails Check 7 verifiability and A4's autonomous_completion for an issue that actually has a valid resolved decision. The gap is present today (MATCH).
